name: feline-health-advisory
title_zh: 把猫的异常行为翻译成一份就医优先级清单
tagline_zh: 猫呕吐、乱尿、嗜睡时，你分不清是矫情还是急症。它按风险排序给出「今晚急诊 / 明天门诊 / 再观察」的具体动作。
tagline_en: When your cat vomits, pees outside the box, or hides all day—get a risk-ranked plan: ER tonight, clinic tomorrow.
why_zh: 不靠症状猜病名，而是用决策树把行为信号映射到风险等级，每一步都给出可执行的下一步。
why_en: No symptom-to-disease guessing. It maps behaviors to risk tiers via a decision tree, giving you the next concrete step—not a.
limit_zh: 只覆盖行为异常（呕吐/乱尿/嗜睡/食欲变化），不处理外伤、中毒、呼吸困难等急症；且不给诊断，只给就医优先级和提问清单。
limit_en: Only behavioral signs (vomiting, inappropriate urination, lethargy, appetite change). No trauma, poisoning, or dyspnea. No diagnosis—just triage.
